title: Math · Grade 5
description: An original starter path: build the idea, work an example, then try it. A focused introduction, ready to grow with your class.
framework: Original introductory mathematics practice; suggested grade placement, not a complete standards syllabus.
sequenceNote: Suggested teaching sequence, not mandated unit order.
alignmentNote: Starter course; not full grade-level coverage.

lessons.title: Decimal operations
lessons.reading: Line up decimal places to add or subtract. Each column must combine equal place-value units.
lessons.easyReading: Line up decimal places to add or subtract. Each column must combine equal place-value units.
lessons.expertReading: Line up decimal places to add or subtract. Each column must combine equal place-value units. Adding zeros to represent equal precision helps align units without changing values.

application.explanation: 5.87. Line up decimal places to add or subtract. Each column must combine equal place-value units.

vocab.definition: A position that specifies a power-of-ten unit.

lessons.practice: Explain how decimal place helps solve the question. Include the numbers or properties that support your answer.
lessons.reflection: 5.87. Line up decimal places to add or subtract. Each column must combine equal place-value units.

lessons.title: Unlike denominators
lessons.reading: Rename fractions using a common denominator before adding them. The new parts must have the same size.
lessons.easyReading: Rename fractions using a common denominator before adding them. The new parts must have the same size.
lessons.expertReading: Rename fractions using a common denominator before adding them. The new parts must have the same size. Any common multiple works, though the least common multiple often keeps numbers smaller.

application.explanation: 3/4. Rename fractions using a common denominator before adding them. The new parts must have the same size.

vocab.definition: A shared denominator used to express fractions in equal-sized parts.

lessons.practice: Explain how common denominator helps solve the question. Include the numbers or properties that support your answer.
lessons.reflection: 3/4. Rename fractions using a common denominator before adding them. The new parts must have the same size.

lessons.title: Multiply fractions
lessons.reading: A fraction of a fraction can be represented by overlapping partitions. Multiply numerators and denominators.
lessons.easyReading: A fraction of a fraction can be represented by overlapping partitions. Multiply numerators and denominators.
lessons.expertReading: A fraction of a fraction can be represented by overlapping partitions. Multiply numerators and denominators. Multiplication by a positive fraction less than one scales a positive quantity down.

application.explanation: 2/5. A fraction of a fraction can be represented by overlapping partitions. Multiply numerators and denominators.

vocab.definition: A number multiplied by another number to form a product.

lessons.practice: Explain how factor helps solve the question. Include the numbers or properties that support your answer.
lessons.reflection: 2/5. A fraction of a fraction can be represented by overlapping partitions. Multiply numerators and denominators.

lessons.title: Volume fills space
lessons.reading: Volume counts cubic units inside a solid. A rectangular prism has equal layers whose areas can be multiplied by height.
lessons.easyReading: Volume counts cubic units inside a solid. A rectangular prism has equal layers whose areas can be multiplied by height.
lessons.expertReading: Volume counts cubic units inside a solid. A rectangular prism has equal layers whose areas can be multiplied by height. Area times height yields volume because multiplying square units by a length produces cubic units.
lessons.worked: A 4 by 3 by 2 prism contains 4 × 3 × 2 = 24 cubic units.
steps: A 4 by 3 by 2 prism contains 4 × 3 × 2 = 24 cubic units.

application.prompt: Find the volume of a 5 by 2 by 3 prism.
application.explanation: 30 cubic units. Volume counts cubic units inside a solid. A rectangular prism has equal layers whose areas can be multiplied by height.

vocab.definition: The amount of three-dimensional space occupied by a solid.

lessons.practice: Explain how volume helps solve the question. Include the numbers or properties that support your answer.
lessons.reflection: 30 cubic units. Volume counts cubic units inside a solid. A rectangular prism has equal layers whose areas can be multiplied by height.

lessons.title: Read ordered pairs
lessons.reading: An ordered pair lists horizontal position first and vertical position second. Begin at the origin and move along the axes.
lessons.easyReading: An ordered pair lists horizontal position first and vertical position second. Begin at the origin and move along the axes.
lessons.expertReading: An ordered pair lists horizontal position first and vertical position second. Begin at the origin and move along the axes. Reversing coordinates usually identifies a different point.
lessons.worked: For (3, 2), move three units right and two units up.
steps: For (3, 2), move three units right and two units up.

application.prompt: Which point is four right and one up from the origin?
application.explanation: (4, 1). An ordered pair lists horizontal position first and vertical position second. Begin at the origin and move along the axes.

vocab.definition: Two coordinates written in a specified order to locate a point.

lessons.practice: Explain how ordered pair helps solve the question. Include the numbers or properties that support your answer.
lessons.reflection: (4, 1). An ordered pair lists horizontal position first and vertical position second. Begin at the origin and move along the axes.
